The '''Lannik Space''' was a sector located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was home to the planets [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] and [[Dractu]]. It was galactic north of the [[Lannik Wilds]], and bordered [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] to the south.
